description: Action1 endpoints that curated tools call although the pinned OpenAPI spec does not document them. tests/unit/curatedPaths.test.ts fails when a curated tool uses an undocumented path that is not listed here, or when a listed path becomes documented or unused. scripts/fetch-spec.mjs --check reports each entry against the live spec. Background: docs/GOTCHAS.md.

endpoints.note: Legacy alias of POST /automations/instances/{orgId} (PSAction1 convention). Windows run-now paths use it; macOS uses the documented path.
The documented equivalent is GET /vulnerabilities/{orgId}?endpoint_id=... action1_cve_remediation_plan uses that and falls back to this path only on a 404.
